scope: known supervised capacity baseline; no innovation or paper-gate claim
metric_scale: [0,1]; deltas times100 are absolute percentage points
target_policy: native initial target ID; no union

train.weighting: 24 events per parent, four equal parents
train.endpoint_policy: all fixed events including4 final-frame events; duplicates retained

dev.endpoint_policy: exclude first/last from means; all raw metrics retained
dev.weighting: equal two parents; equal interior frames within parent

continuation.meaning: known-baseline capacity continuation only; not new method or final evidence

cost_note: Inherited cache, complete two-arm fit and prediction costs separate; nested times not added twice.
